observed.adapter: Better Auth Drizzle adapter over node-postgres

proves: Better Auth email signup and password sign-in use the selected Drizzle PostgreSQL adapter.
The bearer session remains readable after the first pool is closed and a second pool/adapter instance is created.
User and session rows are persisted in PostgreSQL and are not memory-only state.
Better Auth authentication does not grant an operator role.
doesNotProve: Email delivery, verification, reset or 2FA provider behavior.
Final production operator-role administration, step-up policy and migration release promotion.
